capabilities: Publish changed notes to Confluence pages
Pull Confluence edits into notes with conflict markers
Import new Confluence pages as notes and folders
Turn Confluence page links into wikilinks
Render Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX equations as images
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later. Imports settings and page links from the original Confluence Integration plugin on first load. Credentials are kept in Obsidian secret storage; the plugin collects no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Confluence Integration Plus is a fork of the Confluence Integration plugin from the markdown-confluence project
problem: Notes and their Confluence pages drift apart because keeping both in step means copying content by hand.

relations.evidence: Confluence Integration Plus is a fork of the Confluence Integration plugin from the markdown-confluence project

requires.name: Atlassian Cloud account with access to a Confluence site
Atlassian API token or OAuth client credentials

summary: Publishes vault notes to Atlassian Confluence Cloud and pulls Confluence page edits back into the notes.
